name: move a live classic Notepad window

steps.name: launch a fresh classic Notepad window
argv: $target = Join-Path (Get-Location) 'notepad-target.txt'; Set-Content -Path $target -Value 'cuse drag reliability target'; $process = Start-Process "$env:SystemRoot\System32\notepad.exe" -ArgumentList $target -PassThru; [Console]::Write($process.Id)

steps.name: capture the window position before the drag
argv: $window = ((& ./cuse windows --json | ConvertFrom-Json).data | Where-Object { $_.title -match 'notepad-target' } | Select-Object -First 1); if ($null -eq $window) { throw 'notepad-target window was not found before the drag' }; @{ x = [int]$window.x; y = [int]$window.y; fromX = [int]$window.x + [int]($window.width / 2); fromY = [int]$window.y + 10; toX = [int]$window.x + [int]($window.width / 2) + 150; toY = [int]$window.y + 130 } | ConvertTo-Json -Compress

steps.name: drag the live window by its title bar
capture the window position after the drag
argv: $window = ((& ./cuse windows --json | ConvertFrom-Json).data | Where-Object { $_.title -match 'notepad-target' } | Select-Object -First 1); if ($null -eq $window) { throw 'notepad-target window was not found after the drag' }; $deltaX = [int]$window.x - ${steps.before.json.value.x}; $deltaY = [int]$window.y - ${steps.before.json.value.y}; @{ x = [int]$window.x; y = [int]$window.y; deltaX = $deltaX; deltaY = $deltaY; maxAbsoluteDelta = [Math]::Max([Math]::Abs($deltaX), [Math]::Abs($deltaY)) } | ConvertTo-Json -Compress
